Discover a fresh approach to gathering every detail of information about the BMW i Series through BMW i Hub, all at your fingertips.  Find your most suitable BEV by clicking the link in bio or get in touch with your nearest dealer.

Ready to experience the adrenaline rush of accelerating from 0 to 100 km/h in just 4.1 seconds? Equipped with automatic transmission, #TheUltimatePurist is eagerly waiting to take you into the JOY of thrilling performance and speed.  #TheUltimatePurist #TheUltimateBMW

Enjoy a home charging solution with the BMW Wallbox, designed for your BMW i Series or Plug-in Hybrid. It offers up to 22 kW of power, showcases an LED status bar for progress updates, and comes with a wall mount and cable holder for a neat installation.  To learn more about BMW i charging, click the link in bio or contact your nearest dealer.
Make a statement on the road with the power, prestige, and style that THE BOSS possesses.  Contact your nearest BMW Authorized Dealer or visit bmw.co.id to learn more about THE NEW X5.  #BeTheBoss

With our unwavering commitment to a more sustainable tomorrow, we are delighted to deliver THE iX to the Ministry of the State Secretariat for notable state guest events.   THE iX is 100% electric, allowing you to drive without any local emissions or fossil fuels.  Learn more about the no. 1  premium electric vehicle by visiting bmw.co.id or contact your preferred BMW Authorized Dealers.  #BornElectric

We're officially @artjakarta's VIP Mobility Partner. BMW will provide THE iX for an electrifying and emissions-free experience unique to our Sheer Driving Pleasure for all the artists coming.  On top of that, THE 8 X JEFF KOONS will also be present as an exclusive display.  Come visit us and see the very limited edition of THE 8 X JEFF KOONS at Art Jakarta, JIEXPO Kemayoran, 17-19 November 2023. We can't wait to meet you, see you there!

In collaboration with @bmw.eurokars, BMW Indonesia is delighted to announce the delivery of five high-performance BMW vehicles in support of the Pertamax Turbo Ultimate Experience 2023 event.   This exciting event is scheduled to take place from 17-19 November 2023, at Pertamina Mandalika International Circuit in Lombok.   The lineup for this prestigious occasion includes THE THE M2, THE M3, THE M4, THE XM, and THE i4, which will take on the role of the lead car during this event.  Learn more about the BMW M and i Series on bmw.co.id.

THE i7 takes the lead as the chosen sustainable transportation partner for the ASEAN Defense Ministers' Meeting 2023, scheduled from 14-17 November 2023.   Its presence signifies a commitment to environmental responsibility, showcasing how innovation can seamlessly blend with luxury.  To know more about THE i7, visit bmw.co.id or contact your preferred BMW Authorized Dealers.  #TheFutureofLuxury #THEi7

Inspired by the JOY of Sheer Driving Pleasure, the iconic event of BMW Car Clubs Indonesia @bmwcci.official has returned with its National Annual Meeting (Munas) and Indonesian Bimmerfest (IBF) 2023.   This event, which took place in Mandalika, Lombok on November 10-11, 2023, is also supported by @bmwtunas. With the theme 'Mandalika Unites All,' it aims to maximize the emission-free electrifying experience at the Mandalika Circuit with THE iX.   To learn more about THE iX, visit bmw.co.id or by clicking the link in our bio.
